responsibility: Implements scanner-driven validation and parsing of signed and unsigned decimal whole numbers. It owns the finite-state procedures that classify characters as padding, valid digits, terminators, or invalid input, converts validated strings into INTEGER or CARDINAL values while handling sign and special MIN(INTEGER) range behavior, computes decimal digit counts for output sizing, and raises a dedicated EXCEPTIONS source when invalid signed or unsigned conversions are requested.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the conversion engine behind WholeConv: unlike the same-stem .def specification, it implements the scanner states for signed and unsigned decimal text, computes numeric values and lengths, and allocates/raises the module’s EXCEPTIONS source on invalid conversions.
